title: Hypothesized relative position learning from sinusoidal encodings
description: The authors hypothesize that sinusoidal positional encodings allow the model to easily learn to attend by relative positions, but this is stated as a hypothesis and not proven.
canonical_description: sinusoidal positional encodings enable relative position learning, but only hypothesized

evidence.anchor: we hypothesized it would allow the model to easily learn to attend by relative positions
evidence.quote: We chose this function because we hypothesized it would allow the model to easily learn to attend by relative positions, since for any fixed offset $k$, $PE_{pos+k}$ can be represented as a linear function of $PE_{pos}$.
